The art of the possible · the console

What your agents could see

A live call in one console: AI classifies the interaction, detects the repeat contact, pulls the Member 360 on command, surfaces knowledge at 96% relevance and coaches the next best action in real time.

This is not a concept. It’s a working POC I built, rebranded for ACG.

acg.lightning.force.com/console/voice-call
acg.lightning.force.com/member-360
The art of the possible · one member view

One member, one view

Membership, policies, household, cases and sales opportunities on one record. The AI flags what’s worth a conversation: the 16-year-old not on the auto policy, the bundle review due at renewal.

Service sees sales. Sales sees service. No department operates in silos.

The art of the possible · dashboards

What leadership could see

Deflection, speed, handle time, verification, and the number nobody else shows you: revenue intelligence on service calls. Every conversation read by AI for the cross-sell that happened, or the one that walked out the door, with the reason in the AI’s own words.

Service centers measure cost. This measures revenue too.

acg.lightning.force.com/dashboards/sales
The art of the possible · topic intelligence

Every topic, not just the first intent

A call starts as an ID card request and shifts three times. The AI captures all of it: 513 topics in one month, 4.6 per conversation, what customers raise versus what agents raise, and a heatmap of topics by interaction type.

This is the report that tells you what members actually call about, and where to invest next.

contact-center-dashboards/topics
contact-center-dashboards/agents
The art of the possible · agent analytics

Down to every agent

Calls and chats by agent, which interaction types each agent carries, speed to answer and handle time. And the number on top: 59 conversations handled start to finish by the AI agent alone.

Coaching, staffing and deflection decisions stop being guesswork.

What I do
